SELECT USER_ID, PW, USER_NM ,(SELECT CODE_ID FROM TB_M_CODE_MANAGEMENT WHERE PARENT_ID = 'ROLE') AS ROLE_DESC , DESK_DIV,EMAIL, HP_NO, MAIL_YN, SMS_YN, USER_COLOR, to_char(USE_STA_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') as USE_STA_DATE, to_char(USE_END_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') as USE_END_DATE FROM TB_M_USERINFO WHERE USER_ID = #{usr_id}
UPDATE TB_M_USERINFO SET USER_NM = #{usr_nm}, DESK_DIV = #{usr_dept}, EMAIL = #{usr_email}, HP_NO = #{usr_hp}, MAIL_YN = #{usr_mailyn}, SMS_YN = #{usr_smsyn} WHERE USER_ID = #{usr_id}
